pages.text: Build each 5x5 pattern around a Blank Magic Center, then strike the center with a Ritual Dagger.$(br2)A = Attack, D = Defense, R = Regeneration, C = Center, . = empty. Patterns may be rotated. Every unmarked position must remain empty.

pages.title: Forcefield Center
pages.text: D.D.D$(br).DRD.$(br)D.C.D$(br).DRD.$(br)D.D.D$(br2)Always blocks lightning. Also blocks ownerless, mob-owned, and blacklisted-player projectiles and ranged attack entities, plus blacklisted players, their other attacks, and enabled mob categories. Nonblacklisted players and non-lightning attacks they own pass freely. Outside explosions cannot destroy blocks inside the field. An expanding boundary carries blocked nearby entities outward. Items and experience pass. Spirit stones absorb 10/100/1000 damage; an unfueled broken ward explodes.

pages.title: Scorching Center
pages.text: A...A$(br).A.A.$(br)R.C.R$(br).A.A.$(br)A...A$(br2)Burns and damages enemies each second, drains 1% maximum Qi, removes Frozen effects, reduces healing, strengthens fire techniques, and raises ice-technique cost.

pages.title: Sanctuary Center
pages.text: R.R.R$(br)..D..$(br)R.C.R$(br)..D..$(br)R.R.R$(br2)Grants Regeneration II, restores 1% maximum Qi each second, improves natural Qi recovery, shortens fire, and removes minor Poison and Weakness.

pages.title: Frost Center
pages.text: D.R.D$(br).D.D.$(br)A.C.A$(br).R.R.$(br)D.R.D$(br2)Slows, extinguishes, freezes, and applies Frozen Qi. Qi recovery is halved and spell costs rise. Fire techniques erode Frozen Qi.

pages.title: Decay Center
pages.text: A.R.A$(br).A.A.$(br)R.C.R$(br).A.A.$(br)A.R.A$(br2)Inflicts Wither and Weakness, reduces healing, and raises healing-technique cost. Corpse and Blood Demon cultivators resist part of the effect.

pages.title: Thunder Center
pages.text: A.D.A$(br).R.R.$(br)A.C.A$(br)..D..$(br)A...A$(br2)Every 3 seconds, strikes the hostile target with the most Qi for 20 magic damage plus 1% maximum health. Wet and frozen targets take more. Blocks never ignite.

pages.title: Detection Center
pages.text: D.A.D$(br).R.R.$(br)A.C.A$(br)..D..$(br)A...D$(br2)Reveals intruders and hostile mobs, reports player name and realm once per entry, marks souls, grants Spirit Sight to permitted players, and exposes nearby disguises.

pages.title: Reforge Blade Formation
pages.text: R...R$(br).D.D.$(br)R.C.R$(br).D.D.$(br)R...R$(br2)Place a damageable weapon in the extra weapon slot. While enabled and fueled, the weapon floats above the center and restores 1 durability each second.
